description: Reads a calorie figure typed in the search field for quick add: a whole number 1-5000, optionally followed by "kcal" (any case, optional space). Anything else returns null.

cases.why: Typing just 450 offers "Add 450 kcal": a bare number is never a food name.
The explicit form "450 kcal" is read the same as the bare number.
People type "450KCAL" or "450kcal": the unit is case-insensitive and the space optional.
Leading and trailing spaces from the keyboard do not stop the match.
"200 g" is a weight, not an energy: it must stay a search, never become 200 kcal.
A food with a number ("2 pommes") is a search, not a quick add.
Decimals are refused so "1,5" or "1.5" never logs 1 or 15 kcal by accident.
0 kcal is not something to log: the lower bound is 1.
5000 is the largest accepted figure; above it is almost surely a typo.
5001 is refused rather than logged, to catch a slipped extra digit.
